properties.description: The per-class contract for required reference parameters: every required `*_id` whose NAME does not resolve to exactly one declared node type must say its type in its description or name the sibling `*_type` parameter that supplies it — or be EXEMPT with a reason. Membership is DERIVED from the schema (strip `_id`, match declared node types), so a 181st tool joins the class the moment it is served. Failed on 66 parameters across 49 tools when first run; caught its own author copying `element_type` onto a request that has no such field. The generalisation of the shape `every_declared_enum_is_wired_or_exempt` proved on one class.
properties.name: every_reference_parameter_names_its_type.rs
